title: Prime Day Hasn’t Started Yet, but I’ve Already Found Deals Worth Buying
author: Louryn Strampe
text:
All products featured on WIRED are independently selected by our editors. However, we may receive compensation from retailers and/or from purchases of products through these links. Learn more.Amazon Prime Day deals are back, baby. The second sale of the year is officially dubbed Prime Big Deal Days and will arrive on October 6 and 7. However, early deals have already started, and I've been using my 13 years of deal-hunting experience to find true discounts on the gadgets and gear the WIRED Reviews team has hand-tested and would recommend to our friends. Below, you'll find the best early deals we've sleuthed so far. We'll be covering deals throughout the event and beyond. all the way through Black Friday and Cyber Monday.Featured Prime Day DealUpdated: Sep 26 2026, 02:18 PMGoogle Pixel 10a $ 499 $ 424Don't miss our list of Prime Day tips put together by yours truly, plus our guide to Amazon Prime benefits you might be forgetting to use. Our guide to shopping safe on Amazon might be useful as well.Updated September 26: We've added 10 new deals from Bose, JBL, Anker, SteelSeries, Smartish, Moft, Birch, Razer, Blueair, and FlexiSpot. We've also made sure existing deals are up to date.WIRED Featured DealsThe best phone deal: Google Pixel 10a for $424 ($75 off)The best earbuds deal: Google Pixel Buds Pro 2 for $190 ($41 off)The best robot vacuum deal: Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro for $550 ($250 off)A budget-friendly standing desk: FlexiSpot EN1 Standing Desk for $170 ($40 off)The best Bluetooth speaker: JBL Flip 7 Bluetooth Speaker for $120 ($30 off)Table of ContentsBest Tech DealsBest Home DealsBest Tech DealsA Killer Deal on Our Favorite Android PhonePhotograph: Julian ChokkattuPhotograph: Julian ChokkattuPhotograph: Julian ChokkattuPhotograph: Julian ChokkattuGooglePixel 10a$499 $424 (15% off) Amazon$499 $424 (15% off) Best Buy$499 $424 (15% off) Google StoreThe Google Pixel 10a is our favorite Android phone overall, in part because it's cheap. The low price comes with a ton of value, from the slick performance and powerful cameras to the years of software and security updates.The Best Price on a Budget-Friendly SpeakerPhotograph: Chris HaslamJBLGo 5$55 $40 (27% off) Amazon$55 $40 (27% off) Best Buy$55 $42 (24% off) WalmartThe JBL Go 5 is our top budget Bluetooth speaker. It's available in 10 different colors, most of which are down to a match of the best price we've seen. It's durable, lightweight, and sounds good for its size.A Solid Discount on Workout EarbudsPhotograph: Harry RabinowitzPhotograph: Ryan WaniataBeatsPowerbeats Pro 2$250 $200 (20% off) Amazon$250 $200 (20% off) Best Buy$250 Beats by DreWe see this deal for our favorite workout earbuds pretty regularly, but they only ever get about $20 cheaper, so it's still a solid option if you're in the market. The Beats Powerbeats Pro 2 play well with iOS and Android, have punchy sound, and feature the option for both transparency mode and active noise canceling.The Best Android Earbuds at a Low PricePhotograph: Julian ChokkattuPhotograph: Parker HallPhotograph: Parker HallGooglePixel Buds Pro 2$229 $190 (17% off) Amazon$229 $190 (17% off) Best Buy$229 GoogleThe Google Pixel Buds Pro 2 remain our top earbuds for Android users (they also work with iOS). They're aesthetically pleasing. They sound great. They're comfortable, have a long-lasting battery, and active noise cancellation, plus some useful software features. It could do a better job at cleaning up tricky spills, but it has good suction power, and this is the best price we've seen since it was released.The Best Smart Bird Feeder Is on SalePhotograph: Kat MerckVideo: Kat MerckNetvueBirdfy Lite Smart Bird Feeder$250 $144 (42% off) Amazon (AI ID, Solar)$180 $130 (28% off) Amazon (No AI ID, With Solar)$200 $110 (45% off) Birdfy (No AI ID, No Solar)$230 $130 (43% off) Birdfy (Lifetime AI, No Solar)Our top smart bird feeder is available in a few discounted configurations, but we prefer this one since it comes with AI bird identification and a solar charging panel. It's been slightly cheaper before, but this deal is still a good one.An Affordable Air Purifier Ahead of Dust Mite SeasonPhotograph: Molly HigginsPhotograph: Molly HigginsPhotograph: Molly HigginsPhotograph: Molly HigginsLevoitVital 200S-P Air Purifier$190 $170 (11% off) Amazon$190 LevoitI’ve tested air purifiers that cost 10 times as much as this budget Levoit, but I keep coming back to this affordable pick. I really love the connected app, which lets me adjust settings like fan speed and modes from afar and check filter life. Plus, the app sends notifications when air quality is poor and updates when it reaches clean levels again. You can also see historical indoor air quality levels and the corresponding action the purifier took, which helps track patterns. It’s also compatible with Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control. —Molly HigginsA Powerful Vacuum That Can Reach Under FurniturePhotograph: Nena FarrellPhotograph: Nena FarrellPhotograph: Nena FarrellSharkPowerDetect Cordless Stick Vacuum$550 $430 (22% off) Amazon (With Base Station)$449 Amazon$350 SharkNinjaOne of the best cordless stick vacuums you can buy is available in a few different configurations, and one of those options is on sale. The Shark PowerDetect vacuum has powerful suction and a bendable body that can slide under furniture. The base station version comes with more features, and the Speed version is a little cheaper (and our current top pick), but only the sole PowerDetect vacuum is on sale as of press time. —Nena FarrellTake Your Wi-Fi With You for LessPhotograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillTP-LinkRoam 7 (BE3600)$130 $90 (31% off) AmazonBefore it was an honorable mention in our router buying guide, the TP-Link Roam 7 was a top pick. And we still like it!
